slice: P3 selected unmarked MATERIAL diffuse mapper scalar edits
scope: Unchanged captured modern-DXF MATERIAL source with complete diffuse and inferred normal tuples; finite typed diffuse blend, projection, tiling and auto-transform edits, alone or composed with selected normal fields and both mapper matrices.

contract.operation: Bind first and second outer 42/73/74/75 fields around the inferred normal boundary and validate captured values. Replace changed diffuse or normal roles only and re-decode the complete represented output model.
contract.admission: Finite diffuse blend, projection 1–4, tiling 1–3 and existing 0x07 auto-transform mask; the zero mask is an admission policy, not a claim about native behavior.
contract.atomicity: Invalid ranges, nonfinite values, changed field presence, conflicting raw roles and late mutation refuse without replacing the destination or caller state; corrected retry uses the same adapter.

validation.focusedControls: Every nonempty subset of the four diffuse scalar edits composed with normal roles and both matrix edits across four ASCII/binary routes; all admitted projection, tiling and mask values; 16 invalid, presence and raw-conflict refusal/retries per route; three late-mutation stages per source format, preserving sentinel destinations.
validation.chronology: Normal and ASan ran frozen code committed above; independent physical projection was refreshed against the rebuilt shared normal adapter and library.

independentPeer.derivation: Separately authored AC1027 source with distinct diffuse/normal sentinels; specular producer code corrected to 76. The derived input removes unrelated EZDXF_META root and DICTIONARY/DICTIONARYVAR objects; selected MATERIAL tags match the original before document setup.
independentPeer.observations: Independent pre-setup physical-tag projection compared all 94 selected tags across individual edits and their four-field composition in each encoding. Only selected first/diffuse roles changed; second/normal roles and other selected fields remained unchanged.

limitations: Autodesk documents the first diffuse roles and named bit values; this evidence does not certify every combination or native rendering. The 0x07 mask follows existing admission policy.
The inferred normal boundary is qualified only for this selected source; omitted/repeated and other producer profiles require separate evidence.

The source is derived by removing unrelated objects. No full-document fidelity, DWG parity, arbitrary source version, native CAD rendering or broad support claim follows; no drawing fixture is committed.
